steps.title: Define HeyApp Requirements
steps.description: The user wants a simple Android app that displays the text 'Hey'. The primary goal is a minimal UI with a TextView.

steps.title: Set up Android Project Structure for HeyApp
steps.description: Initialize the project with the specified app name 'HeyApp' and package name 'com.heyapp.app'. Ensure correct folder hierarchy for source code and resources.

steps.title: Configure app/build.gradle
steps.description: Set up Gradle build script with compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, minSdkVersion 21, and buildToolsVersion '34.0.0'. Define the application ID as 'com.heyapp.app' and namespace as 'com.heyapp.app'. Ensure Java 8 compatibility and no external dependencies.

steps.title: Create AndroidManifest.xml for HeyApp
steps.description: Generate the AndroidManifest.xml file. Set the package to 'com.heyapp.app', label to 'HeyApp', and specify the main activity 'MainActivity'. Use the '@drawable/icon' for both icon and roundIcon, and set the theme to '@android:style/Theme.Material.Light'.

steps.title: Design activity_main.xml Layout
steps.description: Create the primary layout file activity_main.xml. This layout will contain a single TextView centered on the screen, which will display the 'Hey' message.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java for HeyApp
steps.description: Develop the MainActivity.java file. This activity will be responsible for loading the activity_main.xml layout and programmatically setting the text of the TextView to 'Hey'.

steps.title: Integrate Layout and Activity
steps.description: Ensure that MainActivity properly inflates activity_main.xml and finds the TextView by its ID to set its text content.

steps.title: Verify UI Components
steps.description: Confirm that the TextView is correctly sized, positioned, and styled according to the simple requirement.

steps.title: Prepare for Build
steps.description: Perform a final check on all generated files to ensure they conform to Android development standards and the specified build environment.

steps.title: Building HeyApp
steps.description: The project is ready to be built using Gradle. This step compiles the source code and resources into an installable APK for 'HeyApp'.
